frameworks.name: ISO 22301:2019
frameworks.purpose: Business continuity management system requirements covering establishment, implementation, operation, monitoring, review, maintenance and continual improvement.
frameworks.notes: ISO lists the 2019 second edition as the current published standard; monitor the next edition because standards content changes.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27031:2025
frameworks.purpose: Guidance for ICT readiness to support business continuity and recover from ICT-related disruption.
frameworks.notes: Second edition published May 2025. Treat this as a primary ICT-continuity reference.

frameworks.name: NIST SP 800-34 Rev. 1
frameworks.purpose: Structured contingency planning including BIA, preventive controls, recovery strategies, plans, testing/training/exercises and maintenance.

frameworks.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
frameworks.purpose: Outcome-based cybersecurity risk management taxonomy usable across sectors and maturity levels.

frameworks.name: Basel Committee Principles for Operational Resilience
frameworks.purpose: Principles for banks to deliver critical operations through disruption, including governance, BCP/testing, dependency mapping, third parties, incident management and resilient ICT.

frameworks.name: Digital Operational Resilience Act (EU) 2022/2554
frameworks.purpose: ICT risk management, ICT business continuity, response/recovery, testing, backup/recovery and ICT third-party risk requirements for covered financial entities.

frameworks.name: FCA Operational Resilience
frameworks.purpose: Important business services, impact tolerances, mapping, severe-but-plausible scenario testing, vulnerabilities, response/recovery and third-party dependencies.

frameworks.name: FCA Operational Resilience Insights
frameworks.purpose: Practical observations on impact tolerances, scenario testing, mapping and resilience improvement.

frameworks.name: AWS disaster recovery strategy guidance
frameworks.purpose: Maps recovery objectives to Backup and Restore, Pilot Light, Warm Standby and Multi-site/Active-Active strategies.

frameworks.name: Azure Well-Architected disaster recovery guidance
frameworks.purpose: Business-impact-driven DR design, thresholds, recovery-aware architecture, backups, drills and actionable plans.

frameworks.name: Google Cloud disaster recovery planning guidance
frameworks.purpose: DR planning based on business impact, RTO/RPO, end-to-end recovery, specific procedures, testing and cloud infrastructure outage planning.

cross_framework_principles: Start from critical business services and business impact.
Map people, process, technology, information, facilities and third parties.
Define recovery/impact objectives before selecting technology.
Design end-to-end recovery, not only backup.
Test severe-but-plausible scenarios and record evidence.
Separate cyber recovery from ordinary availability/DR where compromise can propagate into backups or recovery environments.
Review plans after material change and on a defined cadence.
Treat third-party and concentration risk as part of enterprise resilience.
